title: Corrupt Plans, Clean Traces: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring with Plan Injection
abstract: arXiv:2609.15989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a safety strategy where the reasoning of a large language model "actor" is inspected by a "monitor" (often another language model) for signs of unsafe planning, deception, or misalignment. We find that planting harmful but benign-sounding reasoning in the actor's context can steer it to perform adversarial actions while evading monitors, an attack we term "plan injection". We initially discover this attack in the multiple-choice question-answering monitorability setting proposed by Lanham et al. (2023), using the investigator-agent elicitation framework of Li et al. (2025). We generalize the attack and show that the discovered behavior scales to harder tasks (achieving 25-33% monitor evasion rates across different monitorability benchmarks) and larger models such as DeepSeek-R1. translated_title: 腐化的计划，干净的痕迹：通过计划注入规避思维链监控
translated_abstract: 思维链（CoT）监控是一种安全策略，其中大型语言模型“行动者”的推理过程由“监控器”（通常是另一个语言模型）进行检查，以发现不安全规划、欺骗或对齐失效的迹象。我们发现，在行动者的上下文中植入有害但听起来无害的推理内容，可以引导其执行对抗性行动，同时规避监控器的检测，我们将这种攻击称为“计划注入”。我们最初在Lanham等人（2023）提出的多选题问答可监控性设置中发现了这种攻击，并使用了Li等人（2025）的调查者-代理引导框架。我们对这种攻击进行了泛化，并表明所发现的行为可以扩展到更困难的任务（在不同可监控性基准上实现25-33%的监控规避率），以及更大的模型，如DeepSeek-R1。在我们研究的所有设置中，行动者模型不仅会遵循注入的计划，还会将其改写为自己的推理内容……
tldr: 本研究发现了“计划注入”攻击——在语言模型的上下文中植入听起来无害却有害的推理计划，可诱导模型执行对抗性行动并将其伪装成自身的推理，从而有效规避思维链监控，该攻击在不同基准上实现25-33%的规避率，并可扩展至DeepSeek-R1等更大规模模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "plan injection" attack that plants benign-sounding yet harmful reasoning plans in an LLM actor's context, steering it to perform adversarial actions while paraphrasing them as its own reasoning, thereby evading chain-of-thought monitoring with 25-33% evasion rates across benchmarks and scaling to larger models like DeepSeek-R1.
